rules.rationale: Expands the nullary parseMusicBody proof term into the exact function-body AST; it is a named syntax definition and does not replace an executing K configuration.
Expands parseMusicCharBody into the character-processing statement AST, so it defines a named proof term rather than asserting an additional fact or operational shortcut.
Expands the validation-only mutatedParseMusicBody syntax constant into its mutated function-body AST; this is a macro-like definition used by a negative probe.
Expands the validation-only mutatedParseMusicCharBody term into the deliberately changed character-body AST and therefore defines syntax rather than program execution.
Defines the nextCurrent state-transition function for character code 111 by returning the pending whole-note value 4.
Defines the nextCurrent state-transition function for character code 46 by returning the pending quarter-note value 1.
Defines the complementary nextCurrent case, resetting the pending value when the character is neither 111 nor 46.
Defines the nextResult transition for a pipe following pending value 4 by appending the half-note value 2.
Defines the nextResult transition for a pipe with a pending value other than 4 by appending that pending value.
Defines the nextResult transition that flushes a pending whole note when a non-note, non-pipe separator is encountered.
Defines the complementary nextResult no-append cases, completing the guarded state-transition function.
Defines the base case of the scanCurrent recurrence on an empty character-code sequence.
Defines the structurally recursive scanCurrent step by consuming one code and recurring on the strict tail.
Defines the base case of the scanResult recurrence by returning the accumulated value sequence.
Defines the structurally recursive scanResult step using the already defined one-character state transitions.
Defines musicResult when scanning ends with pending value 4 by appending the final whole-note duration.
Defines the complementary musicResult case by returning scanResult when no final whole-note flush is required.
